name: Celine Verxina
original_name: セリーヌ・ヴァルシーナ
source:
Occupation: One of the directors of Closed GAME
Hobbies: Kingcraft
Skills: Shooting (with handguns)
Likes: Everything that [url=https://vndb.org/c26820]Michiko[/url] likes
Dislikes: Everything that Michiko finds boring

Her maiden name is Celine Lockhart, and she is [url=/c26818]Celicia's[/url] younger twin sister. She lived in the same orphanage together with her and [url=/c34672]Tougo[/url], until she was suddenly adopted by Michiko and got separated from them. In her childhood, she used to be introverted and respected Celicia very much, but after growing up she has changed tremendously, even as far as becoming one of the directors for the Closed GAME.
